summary: Expand intratumoral breast necrosis with a sparse ProbNet-derived inflammatory/dead population, or resolve it with atomic dead-to-viable cell turnover; non-nuclear debris remains render-owned.

required_observations: Necrosis component enclosed by or predominantly adjacent to the annotated Tumor component
complete local neoplastic nuclei for appearance; complete dead and neoplastic nuclei for resolution
contraindications: source support lacks explicit Necrosis fine-ID-3 authority
necrosis adjacent only to non-tumor tissue

cell_program.core_policy: appearance removes complete source instances intersecting the changed core and uses ProbNet with the target Necrosis prior to regenerate only inflammatory/dead nuclei; resolution removes every observed complete dead instance and regenerates viable tumor nuclei
cell_program.halo_policy: preserve cells outside changed core except exact whole-instance closure

required_findings: necrotic and viable compartments follow the target mask
veto_findings: fat or retraction cleft rendered as necrosis

necrosis-appearance-v1: necrotic and viable compartments follow the target mask
sparse ProbNet inflammatory/dead nuclei follow the Necrosis target population
bounded generation support renders non-nuclear necrotic material and karyorrhectic texture
necrosis-resolution-v1: necrotic and viable compartments follow the target mask
dead-to-neoplastic population change agrees with the restored viable tumor

necrosis-appearance-v1: fat or retraction cleft rendered as necrosis
intact viable neoplastic nuclei retained inside new necrosis
dense uniform intact dead nuclei substituted for heterogeneous necrotic material
necrosis-resolution-v1: fat or retraction cleft rendered as necrosis
necrotic debris retained in resolved tumor

mask_guarantees: appearance uses ProbNet target-population regeneration with classes 2/4
render_only_claims: non-nuclear necrotic debris and eosinophilic material
karyorrhectic texture beyond intact CellViT instances

counterexamples: creating necrosis in a retraction cleft
leaving neoplastic nuclei in the new necrotic core
filling the entire core with uniform class-4 instances
resolving necrosis to tumor without viable tumor adjacency

selection_preferences: prefer candidates with the largest safe executable capacity
prefer candidates with greater protected-label clearance and complete-instance capacity
prefer the smallest sufficient tool program
clarification_triggers: the instruction permits multiple materially different executable primitives
